summary: OpenAI released version 1.0.3 of its Codex plugin for Claude Code, containing bug fixes for crashes, environment handling, session scoping, and Windows shell support.

practices.reason: A minor patch release with bug fixes to the Codex plugin that a team integrating it should be aware of but requires no urgent work.
practices.quote: fix: inherit process.env in app-server spawn by @Bhuvanesh09 in https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc/pull/159
